context: A uni student interviews a retired explorer about deep-sea work
purpose: Teach: 海水/ウラン/洞窟/引き上げる/余儀なく/転じ/ストライキ/初級

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 若い頃の海底洞窟探検の話、伺ってもいいですか。
lines.en: May I ask about your undersea cave diving expeditions from when you were younger?
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely curious opening. Soft attack, lean-in quality. Thoughtful pace, the cadence of someone asking permission to enter someone else's memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、私は初級ダイバーから始めて、調査船で二十年勤めたよ。
lines.en: I started as a beginner diver and worked on survey vessels for twenty years.
lines.style: Warm, settled recall. The ease of someone settling into a story they've earned the right to tell. Gentle tempo, eyes distant but present.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海水温の変動と、当時の調査の関係はありましたか。
lines.en: Did the changes in seawater temperature affect the direction of your survey work back then?
lines.style: Intelligent follow-up, not performative. Clear question, respectful pace. He's tracking the thread carefully, listening more than asking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 大きく転じた時期があってね、計画変更を余儀なくされたこともあった。
lines.en: There was a period when the conditions shifted dramatically, and we had to overhaul our plans.
lines.style: Unhurried, the weight of memory in the voice. Slight pause before 'shifted'—he's looking back. Slower pace on the second half, matter-of-fact about disruption.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ウラン濃度の測定なども行ったんでしょうか。
lines.en: Did you also take on measurement work—uranium concentration and things like that?
lines.style: Precise curiosity, specific enough to show he's done his homework. Steady, not rushed. The tone of someone asking the next intelligent question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 周辺海域では試料を引き上げる作業を何度もやった。骨が折れたよ。
lines.en: We hauled samples up from the surrounding waters more times than I can count. It was grueling work.
lines.style: Light chuckle threading through. The fond roughness of a veteran's truth. A slight warmth underneath the 'grueling'—he's not complaining, just being honest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 港湾労働者のストライキで作業が止まった経験は。
lines.en: You must have faced work stoppages when the port workers went on strike.
lines.style: Gentle assumption, not interrogation. Softly stated, giving him the opening to confirm or deny. Sympathetic in the phrasing itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 一度ある。あの時は本当に困った。互いの立場が分かり合えるよう、対話を続けたよ。
lines.en: Once, yes. We were truly stuck. But we kept talking—trying to understand where each side was coming from.
lines.style: Quiet wisdom, the voice of someone who learned patience the hard way. Gentle on 'stuck,' then a small shift to conviction on the second half. Close with a soft, almost philosophical warmth.
